page-enter.description: Route content fades and rises 10*--px on mount (.52s, out-soft).

reveal-rise.description: Block rises from 13*--px when 5% visible 12% above the fold bottom (.7s).

char-sweep.description: Hover/active sweep of a label's characters to accent (.4s, 16ms stagger).

scroll-char-wave.description: Pinned statement whose characters light up with scroll progress (char-wave .4s).

marquee-loop.description: Continuous horizontal loop of a duplicated row (28s default, linear).

count-up.description: Stat value counts 0 -> value over 900ms when 60% visible.

hero-3d-entrance.description: Hero lines and portrait tilt up into place after the intro (.95s).

image-trail.description: Pointer travel stamps artwork thumbnails (every 90*--px, 840ms wipe, max 4 live).

clip-reveal.description: Block clip-path opens from inset(5% 7% 0 7%) to inset(0) over 60% of the viewport.

accordion-height.description: Answer row animates grid rows 0fr -> 1fr with fade (500ms).

menu-slide.description: Panel slides in from the right (.62s) and out (.42s) over a scrim.

route-curtain.description: Night curtain covers (667ms), route swaps, curtain lifts (754ms).

intro-sequence.description: Letters rise, image chip cycles every 230ms, overlay fades; 6000ms first visit / 3000ms repeat safety.

plane-inertia.description: Drag/wheel/arrow panning with 0.95 friction and a 620px lens (scale 0.92-1.1, <=4deg tilt).

inview-video.description: Muted video plays only while in view.
